source: https://wiki.guildwars2.com/wiki/Astral_force, https://wiki.guildwars2.com/wiki/Celestial_Avatar (read 2026-09-23). Astral force fills 0.75 % of the bar per strike and 1.5 % per heal on a damaged target (condition damage and barrier give none); Celestial Avatar needs a full bar (the API publishes cost 100 on skill 31869), drains the bar to 0 over its 15 s Duration fact, gains nothing while active, and an early exit loses 50 % of what remains; since 2015-10-27 astral force no longer degenerates out of combat (Celestial Avatar version history), so a fight starts with the bar its player brought. Shroud forms live in shroud.json.
